question_summary: Subcontractor requests approval to substitute ABS DWV piping for the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping (Section 22 13 16) before ordering material, citing supplier lead times.
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV piping in lieu of the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day
routing_rationale: Per routing policy, substitution requests with an associated cost impact are routed to the Cost/Change-Order Manager.
